chunks: "Hajj is the jihad of the weak, and we are the weak."

key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad al-Sadiq عليه السلام
key_terms.الضُّعَفَاءِ: the weak, those without the capacity for martial struggle
key_terms.اَلْحَجُّ: hajj, the pilgrimage to the Sacred House
key_terms.جِهَادُ: striving in the path of Allah; here, a spiritually weighty act of devotion

ai.seo_question: How is hajj described in the hadith of Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith describes hajj as a form of jihad suited to those who do not engage in physical fighting. It highlights the great spiritual rank and striving contained in hajj as an act of worship.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2254 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"Hajj is the jihad of the weak, and we are the weak."
